wire.t: Week 10 kicks off tonight with Washington at the New York Giants, 8:15 PM ET on Prime Video. In our lineups: Jayden Daniels and Malik Nabers for I Chase Brown Kids, Cam Skattebo for OBJAY, Austin Ekeler for Asian Jim, Stefon Diggs for Dude, Your Getting a Dell, Devin Singletary for Bourbon Lover and Isaiah Likely for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix.

Giants coach Jim Harbaugh said J.J. McCarthy 'does look like he's going to play' and Cam Skattebo 'should be full-go.' Neither one is on Wednesday's final Giants report. McCarthy sits on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench.

Bill_Buttlicker added Ashton Dulin and dropped 22-year-old running back Jordan James Wednesday morning, after the last edition went out. Dulin is on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench, and Makai Lemon is still in the lineup on Philadelphia's bye.

Jakobi Meyers and Denzel Boston, two StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte starters, both missed Wednesday practice. Bhayshul Tuten and Rhamondre Stevenson also sat, so Jefferson’s Reserve and Dude, Your Getting a Dell have something to watch on Friday's report.
Mike Evans hasn't played since Oct. 19, and Mike Garafolo called him 'questionable at best' for Sunday against Dallas. He did not practice Wednesday. Evans is on the Jefferson’s Reserve roster.

Puka Nacua (Hold My DK) and Josh Jacobs (The Champ) both missed Wednesday practice and are listed Out on Sleeper. Both teams already have them out of the lineup. TreVeyon Henderson is listed Out for New England, and he's on The Champ's bench.
Byes this week are Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay. Sleeper's Week 10 matchup shows one bye-week starter left in the whole league, and it's Makai Lemon on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte.

stories.title: Week 10 starts tonight, and the only bye-week starter left in the league belongs to the guy who runs this site
stories.dek: Washington at the Giants brings seven of our starters. StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte brings Makai Lemon on a bye and two receivers who missed practice.
body: Washington plays at the Giants at 8:15 tonight, and seven league starters are in it. I Chase Brown Kids has the most riding on it with Jayden Daniels and Malik Nabers. ZachCarroll09 is 3‑6 and a 17.7-point favorite over Bourbon Lover, and Devin Singletary is playing for paknight12 in the same game. OBJAY has Cam Skattebo, Asian Jim has Austin Ekeler, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has Isaiah Likely and Dude, Your Getting a Dell has Stefon Diggs.

Now for my own team. Sleeper's Week 10 matchup shows exactly one bye-week player in a starting lineup across all twelve teams, and it's Makai Lemon, in the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte lineup on Philadelphia's bye. Jakobi Meyers and Denzel Boston, two more of my starters, missed Wednesday practice. Kaleb Johnson is on my bench. Wednesday morning I picked up Ashton Dulin, a 29-year-old receiver, dropped Jordan James, a 22-year-old running back, and then left Dulin on the bench too. In a dynasty league. With 12 first-round picks. I'm a 47.2-point underdog to Hold My DK and I've earned all of it.

Everybody else has sorted out the byes. Catfan94’s Farm Team, OBJAY, Jefferson’s Reserve, Kraft for Cash and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix all had bye-week players in the lineup as of Wednesday morning, and Sleeper's matchup now shows them all replaced. TheMoneyTeam2302 moved Caleb Williams out and put Patrick Mahomes and Aaron Rodgers in, and Puka Nacua is in an IR slot.

Hold My DK is still 8‑1 without Puka Nacua and still the second-biggest favorite on the board. The biggest is The Champ by 62.1 over Dude, Your Getting a Dell, where Rhamondre Stevenson missed Wednesday practice. Br0phy is 0‑9 and has to go 1‑0 at some point. This doesn't look like the week.

stories.title: The Champ spends $2 on Audric Estime, OBJAY beats everybody to Kyle McCord, and Hold My DK loses Puka Nacua
stories.dek: One waiver claim, five free-agent moves before sunrise and a Week 10 that just got harder for an 8‑1 team.
body: The only waiver claim this week went to TJohn91, who paid $2 for Audric Estime and dropped Matt Hibner. Estime had 15 carries for 72 yards and a touchdown in his first game for New Orleans, and Josh Jacobs is listed Out with a fractured finger. The Champ is 4‑5 with a 59-40 all-play record, and that's the kind of cheap move a team like that should make.

JAY2913 was up early. OBJAY added Laquon Treadwell, cut him 93 seconds later for Tutu Atwell, swapped Cade Klubnik for Corey Kiner, then dropped Tua Tagovailoa for Kyle McCord. That last one is a good move: Malik Willis went on IR Tuesday, McCord starts at Indianapolis, and Bo Nix is on bye. In a superflex league, a starting quarterback is a starting quarterback, and Tua had -0.64 points total on OBJAY's bench this season.

The bad news is at the top. Puka Nacua scored 32.5 in Week 9 for Hold My DK, and now he's out for Week 10 and likely headed to IR with MCL and PCL sprains and turf toe. Week 15 is the earliest he can come back. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 8‑1, owns no first-round picks through 2029, and has to keep winning without his best receiver. The line against StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte drops from 41.2 to 35.2.

And Bill_Buttlicker? Kaleb Johnson had 14.3 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench in Week 9 and led Green Bay in rushing, while Makai Lemon is in the lineup on Philadelphia's bye week. Tyler has until Sunday to fix that, and he's been told.

stories.title: Week 9 recap: Catfan94’s Farm Team drops 180.30, The Champ loses with the highest losing score, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑9
stories.dek: A 97.38-point blowout, a 6.28-point nail-biter and three starters below zero.
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 82.92, a 97.38-point margin and the biggest of the week. Kenneth Walker III had 36.8, Brock Purdy 31.28, Christian Watson 28.6 and Bucky Irving 27.5. jrsmith1391 is 6‑3 and has won two straight.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat The Champ 164.84 to 127.74. Jordan Love scored 42.18, Ja'Marr Chase 30.0 and Brock Bowers 24.3, and Catfan94 is 8‑1 with five wins in a row. TJohn91 had the highest losing score of the week and still lost by 37.10. Josh Jacobs scored -0.5 in the lineup, and Boutte (29.5) and Matthew Stafford (13.22) sat on the bench.

Hold My DK beat Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 86.20 behind Puka Nacua at 32.5 and Christian McCaffrey at 23.7. Kraft for Cash beat I Chase Brown Kids 121.74 to 99.86, and Asian Jim beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 68.34, which is the lowest score of the week. Br0phy is 0‑9.

StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte beat OBJAY 115.16 to 108.88 by 6.28, the closest game of the week. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑6 with Drake Maye at 24.76. JAY2913 had Efton Chism III on the bench with 14.4, and swapping him in for Emeka Egbuka (6.4) would have won it 116.88 to 115.16.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks, and four contenders own none
stories.dek: The picks through 2029 are lopsided, and the standings are too.
body: Counting 2027 through 2029, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte owns 12 first-round picks, which is a full first round's worth of picks. JAY2913 is next with six on OBJAY, then ZachCarroll09 with five on I Chase Brown Kids and Br0phy with four on Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

Kraft for Cash, Catfan94’s Farm Team, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK own zero first-round picks over that stretch, and they are the top four teams in the standings. That's a bet on now, and it's working while the whole group is 6‑3 or better.
The risk is that all four teams are on the wrong side of a rebuild in three years, and the one with 12 first-round picks is 3‑6 with 27-72 all-play. Tyler's plan is a long one.

columns.title: Kyle McCord is on OBJAY's bench, and that's the right call
columns.dek: JAY2913 picked up a starting quarterback and didn't start him. It holds up.
body: People are going to tell you JAY2913 wasted a 6:43 AM pickup. Kyle McCord is on the OBJAY bench and Geno Smith is starting. I'll tell you the truth: that's fine.

Bo Nix is on bye, and McCord is superflex insurance who hasn't taken a snap for Miami yet. You don't throw a guy into your lineup on his first NFL start because he was the last name on the waiver wire. Geno Smith is the safer floor this week, and JAY2913 took the floor.

What I don't like is a 4‑5 team that's 27.6 points behind Catfan94’s Farm Team needing everything to go right. Woody Marks, Omar Cooper Jr. and Dalton Kincaid are all questionable. Read the Friday report, JAY2913. Then read it again on Sunday morning.
And Bill_Buttlicker, if you're reading your own website: Makai Lemon. That's it. That's the column.

columns.title: 4 waiver-wire tips from Holden McGroin, who once bid $100 on a kicker in Week 16
columns.dek: Wednesday is for picking people up. Holden is for picking up bad habits.
body: 1. Bid $2 on everybody. TJohn91 bid $2 on Audric Estime and got a guy who led the Saints with 16 touches. If $2 works once, $2 works always. That's science.
2. Hold every player for at least 93 seconds. JAY2913 kept Laquon Treadwell for exactly that long. Any shorter and it's a crush, not a commitment.
3. Never pick up a quarterback who's starting. Kyle McCord starts for Miami this week, and JAY2913 grabbed him anyway. Real strategists wait until a guy's benched, so you get him cheap.

4. Keep your bye-week players in the lineup out of loyalty. Bill_Buttlicker has Makai Lemon starting on Philadelphia's bye and Kaleb Johnson (14.3 last week) on the bench. I respect it. Tyler doesn't, and he's the one who has to look at it.

columns.title: Audric Estime is worth 36 yards per dollar
columns.dek: The Champ paid $2, OBJAY paid 93 seconds, and I measured both.
body: TJohn91 paid $2 for Audric Estime, who ran for 72 yards in his Saints debut. That's 36 rushing yards per FAAB dollar, which my model rates as the most efficient purchase in league history, because I only started measuring this morning.

Laquon Treadwell was on OBJAY for 93 seconds. Tutu Atwell has been there for more than two and a half hours, which is over 100 times as long. By my math, JAY2913's commitment to wide receivers is up 10,000%, and I didn't round much.

Tua Tagovailoa scored -0.64 points in nine weeks on OBJAY's bench, which is -0.07 per week. Kyle McCord has scored 0.00 for OBJAY. That's a 0.07-point weekly upgrade before he's taken a snap, and it's my favorite stat of the season.
Puka Nacua scored 32.5 of Hold My DK's 147.12 in Week 9, which is 22.1%. TheMoneyTeam2302 now has to replace 22.1% of a team. My spreadsheet says that's about one Puka Nacua.

exits.t: Scored 50.36 on the bench in Week 9 on a team that lost 180.30 to 82.92. Jefferson’s Reserve has five quarterbacks, so he wants out of the crowded room.
Scored 29.5 on the bench for a team that lost by 37.10 while Josh Jacobs scored -0.5 in the lineup. Wants a lineup spot.
Scored 14.4 on the bench in a game OBJAY lost by 6.28. Wants a role on a team that checks the bench.
Scored 18.7 on the bench for the second straight week while Ladd McConkey scored 0.0 in the lineup. Wants out of the pine.
Scored 14.3 on the bench in Week 9, and he's back on the bench in Week 10 while Makai Lemon starts on a bye. Wants a manager who opens the app.
Scored 16.48 on the bench for a team with Josh Allen, Jordan Love and Malik Willis ahead of him. Wants a starting job somewhere.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history by 45 points.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, and scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the second-lowest score in league history.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points.

hof.note: Regular season, 2024 through Week 9 of 2026. Playoff trips count 2024-2025.
hof.asterisk: Sleeper history for Gentleman's Dynasty starts in 2024. Anything older is between you and whoever ran it before.

awards.why: Won it all in 2024, then won it again in 2025 as The Champ. Kept the name. Earned it.
12 first-round picks over the next three drafts and the worst all-time record in the league at 10-27. Rich and bad.
Sold every pick in rounds one through four of the next three drafts to go 8-1. Bold. Possibly brilliant. Definitely irreversible.
The highest score in league history, against the team named after him.

banners.line: Made the playoffs in his only season and left on top. Never had to watch anyone score 243.
Owns the lowest score in league history and the third-lowest. When StonesOfBlu went low, he went all the way.
One season, six wins, and a team name we're still thinking about.
